headword: {亭主元気|ていしゅげんき}で{留守|るす}がいい
reading: ていしゅげんきでるすがいい
gloss: a wife is happiest when her husband is out

definitions.gloss: a wife is happiest when her husband is out; better when the husband is healthy and away
definitions.explanation: A humorous proverb expressing that a wife prefers her husband to be healthy enough to go to work and stay out of the house, rather than being home all day. Reflects a traditional housewife perspective on domestic life.

examples.japanese: 「{亭主元気|ていしゅげんき}で{留守|るす}がいい」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The saying 'Better when the husband is healthy and out' was commonly used in the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年退職|ていねんたいしょく}→定年退職：16450_teinentaishoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、「{亭主元気|ていしゅげんき}で{留守|るす}がいい」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧はいかなくなる。
examples.english: Once the husband retires and is home all the time, the 'better when he's away' situation is no more.

examples.japanese: 「{亭主元気|ていしゅげんき}で{留守|るす}がいい」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦フレーズ→フレーズ：19999_fureezu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧、{社会現象|しゃかいげんしょう}になった。
examples.english: The phrase 'better when the husband is healthy and away' originated in an appliance maker's advertisement and became a social phenomenon.

notes:
A humorous proverb popularized in 1986 by a Matsushita Electric (now Panasonic) advertisement campaign. It is now a well-known saying, though it reflects a traditional gender-role perspective.

⟦{亭主|ていしゅ}→亭主：11470_teishu⟧ is an older term for husband (especially by a wife); ⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧ means being away from home or absent. The phrase is often used in the context of husbands retiring and suddenly being home all day (⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧ご⟦{亭主|ていしゅ}→亭主：11470_teishu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{居場所|いばしょ}→居場所：12366_ibasho⟧ = a retired husband with nowhere to go).
